    <p class="rec-title"><a href="/blog/posts/why-99-does-not-feel-like-100/">Why 99% does not feel like 100%</a></p>
    <p class="rec-finding">Removing the last one percent of a risk is worth far more to people than removing a middling one percent, and standard expected-utility reasoning cannot account for the difference. What that does to health decisions, and to the policies built on them.</p>
